class.name: HTMLBehavior
class.brief_description: Base class for project scripts attached to an HTML label.
class.description: Extend this class with a GDScript that can be constructed without arguments. Add it to [member HTMLLabel.behavior_scripts] to register an alias, or refer to a local GDScript path from an HTML [code]<script type="text/gdscript">[/code] element. Enable [member HTMLLabel.behaviors_enabled] to run behaviors. Local [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], [code]uid://[/code], and document-relative script paths are supported; network script URLs are rejected. The behavior exposes its host through [member label] while attached. Timers, frame callbacks, and requests started by this instance are canceled when it detaches.

method.name: _attach
method.description: Called after the host's document has been laid out if [method _attach_document] is not overridden.

method.name: _attach_document
method.description: Called after the host's document has been laid out. Use [param document] to query, create, and edit nodes in the live DOM. The host is also available through [member label]. If both attach hooks are overridden, only this hook is called.

method.name: _detach
method.description: Called when the behavior is detached. [member document] and [member label] remain available during this call. Asynchronous work is canceled immediately after the hook returns.

method.name: cancel_frame
method.description: Cancels a recurring callback created by [method on_frame].

method.name: cancel_request
method.description: Cancels a request created by [method request]. A canceled request does not call its completion callback.

method.name: clear_timer
method.description: Cancels a timeout or interval created by [method set_timeout] or [method set_interval].

method.name: get_document
method.description: Returns the current live DOM. It is available during both attach hooks and [method _detach], and is [code]null[/code] before attachment and after [method _detach] returns.

method.name: get_label
method.description: Returns the attached host or [code]null[/code] outside the behavior's attachment lifecycle.

method.name: get_local_storage
method.description: Returns persistent storage for this document namespace. It is shared by behavior instances using the same namespace.

method.name: get_session_storage
method.description: Returns storage shared by behavior instances on this [HTMLLabel] and retained across its navigations.

method.name: on_frame
method.description: Calls [param callback] every idle frame with the frame delta in seconds. Returns an ID for [method cancel_frame], or [code]0[/code] if the callback is invalid or the behavior is detached.

method.name: request
method.description: Starts an asynchronous HTTP request. [param options] accepts [code]method[/code] (GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS, or PATCH), [code]headers[/code] as a Dictionary, [code]body[/code] as a String, [code]max_body_size[/code], [code]timeout[/code], and [code]track_redirects[/code]. The callback receives a Dictionary with [code]url[/code], [code]status_code[/code], [code]headers[/code], [code]body[/code], and [code]error[/code]. Returns an ID for [method cancel_request], or [code]0[/code] if the URL or options are invalid.

method.name: set_interval
method.description: Calls [param callback] repeatedly at the given interval in seconds. Returns an ID for [method clear_timer], or [code]0[/code] if the callback, interval, or attachment is invalid.

method.name: set_timeout
method.description: Calls [param callback] once after [param delay] seconds. Returns an ID for [method clear_timer], or [code]0[/code] if the callback, delay, or attachment is invalid.

members.member: The live DOM of the attached behavior.
The current host, available from the attach hooks through [method _detach]. It is [code]null[/code] before attachment and after detachment.
Persistent string key-value storage for the current document namespace.
String key-value storage retained for this host's session.
